judge.notes: The candidate reads immediately as a library catalog: manila background, ink text, index-card boxes with double top rules, uppercase sans labels, typewriter values, and a single rubber-stamp red THREAD mark, all matching the brief. Its vertical single-column card stack is a genuinely different shape from the live four-column grid. Craft is decent at 375px with no overflow, but the cards are long and repetitive with a lot of vertical scroll, the thread page leaves a large empty area, and the brief's requirement of a dl per story is plausibly met but the value column is wide and sparse; the 'comments' label is visible but cards lack a distinct card-title hierarchy beyond underlined serif titles.
